summary: The registrant filed an 8-K covering Items 5.07 and 8.01. Item 5.07 reports election of Conor Delaney to the board at the annual meeting, a routine governance matter. Item 8.01 discloses board consent for a privately negotiated unit purchase by HIS Kingdom Holdings from Navy Federal Credit Union. No public tender, price, or premium is stated; the transaction is small and non-public. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or going-private. Therefore, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
